correctness.rationale: R_3(z)=7/12+(5/12)L_3(1+2z/5)=1+z+z²/2+z³/15 follows by Legendre expansion. Exact Q² and Q³ give all entries; Legendre extrema show 1/6≤r(h)≤1 for 0≤h≤5. The factors h(1-h+h²/5) and h²(15-4h)/30 intersect in exactly the two stated closed windows; negative (1,3) excludes every h>15/4. For s=2, diagonals satisfy (1+(1+hq_ii)²)/2>0 and each offdiagonal is h times a linear function with nonnegative value at zero; their intersection is an initial interval for any finite Markov Q. For s=3 and n=2, Q²=-(a+b)Q; all offdiagonals remain nonnegative because 1-r(z)>0 for z>0, the diagonals are positive through z=5, and r strictly decreases thereafter, so recovery is impossible. Strict inequalities at h=3,3.7,4 prove perturbation robustness. The exact-rational checker reports 54,712 regression assertions, not an infinite certification.

value.rationale: RKL2 is used to extend stability-limited diffusion steps, making probability/simplex preservation for conservative generators a natural structural concern. A sign-loss window inside the usual scalar stability interval that later returns to positivity is a nontrivial caution against monotone cutoff heuristics. Proving jointly minimal stages and state dimension and persistence under open rate perturbations makes the exact thresholds more than an arbitrary isolated finite computation. It supports design of positivity-aware step selectors on directed transport/master-equation semidiscretizations. It does not claim stagewise nonlinear SSP, any acceleration benefit, or generalization to higher-dimensional DG schemes.
